name: Cauldron
summary: In the Searing Gorge, Dark Iron miners drive their work at Cauldron under the watch of overseers and fire elementals. Captured slaves labor in its depths, where heat and torment have driven many mad.

sections.title: The Molten Quarry
sections.body: At the center of the Searing Gorge, Cauldron cuts deep into scorched earth. The Dark Irons fortified the pit after Emperor Thaurissan summoned Ragnaros with catastrophic results. Heavy excavation machines scrape rock and ore from the smoldering stone along the canyon walls. Below, fire and magma elementals prowl beside Dark Iron taskmasters. Heat rises from the mountain's depths.

sections.title: The Broken Workforce
sections.body: Captured slaves endure brutal shifts beneath the lash of Dark Iron overseers. Relentless labor, sweltering heat, and torment have driven many mad. They can no longer tell friend from foe. Anyone who disturbs their work is struck, even those who might offer a chance at freedom.

faq.answer: Cauldron is a vast open-pit mine at the center of the Searing Gorge. The Dark Iron clan fortified it to extract stone and ore amid intense volcanic heat.
The Dark Iron clan commands the excavation with heavy machinery and armed overseers. They rule the pit and its laborers.

faq.q: Why do the slaves attack adventurers who try to help?
faq.answer: Cruel torment, blinding heat, and endless exhaustion have driven the slaves mad. They see anyone interrupting their work as a threat and attack those nearby.

faq.q: What kinds of creatures live inside the pit?
faq.answer: Dark Iron overseers and enslaved workers occupy the pit. Fire and magma elementals prowl its fiery fissures.

angles.text: Cauldron's heavy machines and open terraces reveal the scale of Dark Iron mining, cut into unstable volcanic crust.
As a dwarf of Ironforge, seeing the Dark Irons use captured people as broken labor among fire elementals stirs deep disgust.
